items.html: This is the secret of, “and if he is poor, his means do not suffice,” for Tevuna is called “the mother of the sons” — she is the aspect of Dal [34]. This is the aforementioned name, which is above, in the back of the four lower [Sefirot] of Bina, in the aspect of the 4 times 30 combinations mentioned above; and now it has expanded also into Tevuna, who is called “the mother of the sons.”
